title: Figure 7: Theoretical concepts and experimental implementation of an optical hyper-lens
description: Composite figure of hyper-lens concepts: (a) concentric-ring cylindrical structure and (b) spoke-like cylindrical structure credited "Jacob, Alekseyev, Narimanov, Opt.Exp.'06", plus two field-simulation panels credited to Salandrino & Engheta (PRB'06) and Govyadinov & Podolsky (PRB'06). The right panel is a 3D cutaway rendering of a hyperlens on quartz with object plane, conventional lens and far-field image plane, credited "Liu et.al, Science'07". Caption: "Figure 7. Theoretical Concepts (left panel) and Experimental Implementation (right panel) of an Optical Hyper-lens Capable of Magnifying Sub-Diffraction Objects to Observable (larger than λ/2) Size."
